ml4_batch_map.source: Synthetic logs from four wells (seed 21); well W3 has a density-neutron offset; t-SNE perplexity 30 on standardized GR, RHOB, NPHI, PEF.

ml4_biplot.source: Synthetic drilling channels (seed 4); scores coloured by formation after fitting; arrows = loadings x 5 (display scale); RPM and gas load on PC3-PC4.

ml4_case_channels.source: Synthetic drilling channels from three latent drivers plus noise; illustrative relationships; seed 4.

ml4_choose_k.source: Synthetic drilling channels (seed 4); scree and cumulative variance from all 720 minutes; held-out error from PCA fitted on minutes 0-429 and validated on 430-719.

ml4_corr_redundancy.source: Pearson correlations of a synthetic log suite (seed 11); blocks outlined where |r| > 0.7.

ml4_cov_eigen.source: Synthetic drilling channels (seed 4); eigen-decomposition of the 2 x 2 covariance of standardized WOB and torque; arrows = 2 sqrt(lambda).

ml4_curse_geometry.source: Exact formulas for uniform data in the unit cube: 1 - 0.9^d, ball volume pi^(d/2)/Gamma(d/2+1)(1/2)^d, and edge r^(1/d).

ml4_drilling_compression.source: Synthetic drilling channels (seed 4); PCA on standardized minutes 0-429, reconstruction error on minutes 430-719 in original units.

ml4_geodesic.source: Synthetic noisy spiral (seed 0, 400 points); 7-nearest-neighbour graph and scipy shortest path; colour = position along the spiral.

ml4_ica_sources.source: Synthetic sources (seed 1) mixed by a fixed 3 x 3 matrix; FastICA (seed 0); ICA rows reordered and sign-matched for display.

ml4_kernel_pca.source: scikit-learn make_circles (400 points, noise 0.06, seed 0); colours = ring membership, not used in fitting.

ml4_knn_noise.source: Synthetic two-class data with two informative features plus Gaussian noise features; 5 datasets (seeds 0-4) x 5-fold CV.

ml4_l1_path.source: Lasso path (scikit-learn lasso_path) on the synthetic log suite plus 6 noise channels; target log permeability.

ml4_lda_vs_pca.source: Synthetic two-class Gaussian data with a shared covariance (seed 2); d′ = mean difference / pooled SD.

ml4_loadings_heatmap.source: Synthetic drilling channels (seed 4), standardized; rows of PCA components_ (signs fixed so the largest entry is positive).

ml4_log_qc.source: Synthetic log suites (reference seed 11, new well seed 23) with an injected washout at 2120-2138 m; PCA (k = 4) fitted on the standardized reference well.

ml4_mutual_info.source: Synthetic drilling example (seed 7): vibration = resonance peak in RPM + weak WOB effect + noise; MI by the k-NN estimator.

ml4_nmf_parts.source: Synthetic production profiles (seed 9): non-negative mixtures of three shapes plus noise; NMF (k = 3, seed 0) and PCA (k = 3).

ml4_pca_k_cv.source: Synthetic 20-feature data (seed 3): three high-variance nuisance factors; the class signal lies in a low-variance direction.

ml4_production_shapes.source: Synthetic production profiles for 90 wells (seed 13): three shape families, well sizes varying more than tenfold; colours added after fitting.

ml4_recon_anomaly.source: Synthetic drilling channels (seed 4) with an injected SPP drift and a hook-load glitch; PCA (k = 4) fitted on minutes 0-399.

ml4_rfe_curve.source: RFECV with linear regression on a synthetic log suite plus 6 noise channels (seeds 11, 5); band = ±1 SD across folds.

ml4_scaling_pc1.source: Synthetic drilling channels in their units (seed 4): SPP psi, flow gpm, WOB klbf, etc.; first principal component before and after standardization.

ml4_selection_leakage.source: Pure-noise data: 60 rows, random labels, 30 datasets per point (seeds 2000-2029); SelectKBest(k = 10) + logistic regression; 5-fold CV; bands = ±1 SD.

ml4_selection_stability.source: LassoCV refitted in each of 10 contiguous depth folds; synthetic log suite plus 6 noise channels (seeds 11, 5).

ml4_svd_blocks.source: Schematic of the thin singular value decomposition of a centred data matrix.

ml4_swiss_roll.source: scikit-learn make_swiss_roll (1500 points, noise 0.05, seed 0); Isomap k = 10, LLE k = 12, t-SNE perplexity 30; colour = position along the roll.

ml4_tree_importance.source: Random forest (300 trees, seed 0) on the synthetic log suite plus six noise channels (seeds 11, 5); target log permeability.

ml4_trust_compare.source: sklearn.manifold.trustworthiness at k = 10 (continuity = same function with the arguments swapped); Swiss roll seed 0; 600 standardized digit images (seed 42).

ml4_tsne_seeds.source: Six synthetic 10-D Gaussian clusters (make_blobs seed 11); t-SNE perplexity 30 with init="random"; colours = generating cluster, not used in fitting.

ml4_tsne_sizes.source: Synthetic 2-D clusters (seed 0): spreads 0.3 / 1.5 / 0.3, centres at 0, 5, 25; t-SNE seed 0. Spread = RMS distance to the cluster centre.

ml4_umap_schematic.source: Schematic of UMAP parameters drawn by hand; not UMAP output (umap-learn is an optional package).
